name: Twinned Rap
description: Rap with two fingers drawn together like twin threads so that the blow lands in two places.

name: Strand Cover
description: Cross two strands of fortune in front of the body so that blows catch on the crossing.

name: Strand Step
description: Step along one strand and cross to its twin at the moment the foe commits.

name: Parted Strands
description: Part the two strands of the foe's intent with a blow so that guard and attack go different ways.

name: Strand Reading
description: Read the two strands that run from a person to their possible acts and tell which one is drawn tighter.

name: Entwined Fortune
description: Entwine the luck of the user and one ally so that each is lifted by the other's good chance.

name: Strand Snag
description: Snag a strand of the foe's movement so that their next step catches on nothing.

name: Twinned Doom
description: Strike with a doom in each hand so that the foe cannot escape both.

name: Threadbound Ward
description: Bind the ward to two threads of the user's own fate so that it cannot be unpicked from one side alone.

name: Skein Sunder
description: Take hold of the foe's skein and the user's skein together and sunder both with a stroke that favors the user.

name: Entwined Fates
description: Entwine the foe's fate with the user's own for a single stroke so that the blow lands and the foe is bound to the user's luck.

name: Shuttle Rap
description: Rap across the foe's guard like a shuttle through a warp.

name: Warp Cover
description: Stretch warp threads of fortune before the body that catch a blow as cloth catches a hand.

name: Weft Glide
description: Glide across the warp like a weft thread and come out behind the foe.

name: Loomcloth Reading
description: Read the cloth of the fight as it is woven and tell which thread the next stroke will cross.

name: Pattern Strike
description: Strike at the place where the pattern of the fight is about to repeat itself.

name: Knotting Fate
description: Tie a knot in the foe's fate so that each attempt to break away pulls it tighter.

name: Great Weave
description: Weave a great net of chance across the field that snares and strikes every foe it touches.

name: Weaving Mend
description: Weave the torn threads of an ally's body whole again by working a pattern of good fortune into the wound.

name: Tapestry Stroke
description: Pull the whole tapestry of the fight tight at one point and strike there with a blow it cannot turn.

name: Loom Verdict
description: Pass the verdict of the loom upon a foe by cutting the thread of their place in the pattern so that they are struck and slowed together.

name: Portent Knock
description: Knock the foe on the very beat that a portent says they will be open.

name: Portent Cover
description: Take cover from a portent of harm by moving the guard to where it points.

name: Portent Pace
description: Pace out of the way of a portent and come back to it as the danger passes.

name: Augury Taking
description: Take an augury from the pattern of wind and dust and learn what the next breath brings.

name: Sworn Augury
description: Swear to act on the augury and read it with a sure eye that no doubt clouds.

name: Omen Pledge
description: Pledge to meet a coming omen and be given the steadiness to keep the pledge.

name: Portent Snare
description: Snare the foe in their own portent so that each move toward it draws the snare tighter.

name: Augur's Blow
description: Strike a blow read in the augury before it was thrown so that it falls exactly as foreseen.

name: Harbinger Strike
description: Strike as the harbinger of a doom that has already been sworn upon the foe.

name: Portent Aegis
description: Raise an aegis on the side the portent says the blow will come from.

name: Harbinger's Edict
description: Proclaim an edict of fate upon a foe and strike so that the edict is carried out on the spot.

name: Sworn Portent
description: Swear to the wind that the portent will come true and strike so that it does and the foe is slowed beneath it.

name: Destiny Rap
description: Rap at the foe's destiny as if it were an open door and push it a little toward harm.

name: Open Destiny
description: Keep the user's destiny open on all sides so that no single blow can close it.

name: Destiny Pace
description: Pace out of the line the foe's destiny has drawn and into an unmarked one.

name: Destiny Reading
description: Read how fixed a foe's destiny is and where it can be bent.

name: Boon Drawing
description: Draw a boon from the open field of chance and pour it into the user and a nearby ally.

name: Loosed Fate
description: Loose a foe's fate from its course so that their next move fails by a hair.

name: Destined Blow
description: Strike a blow that destiny has marked to land and that breaks past guards set against lesser blows.

name: Clearing Destiny
description: Clear a curse or a clinging taint from an ally or the self by turning the destiny it was bound to.

name: Destiny Break
description: Break the foe's destiny at one point so that the blow lands where nothing was ever fated to stop it.

name: Unwalled Destiny
description: Open the destiny of the whole field so that every foe within it stands in the way of a doom the user chooses.
